description: This script is a Perl program that creates a firmware image by combining kernel and root filesystem images, with options for customization such as addresses, sizes, and image order. It includes functions for reading files, padding data, and generating a specific image format with headers.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding length needed to align data to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align to a specified block size, considering an offset.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Creates a firmware image with a header and combined kernel and root filesystem, then writes it to the output file.
